schemaNotes.coordinates: row and column are CSS grid coordinates, 1-based. Periods remain 1–7. La–Lu are detached at row 8, columns 3–17; Ac–Lr are detached at row 9, columns 3–17. Leave period 6/7 column 3 for 57–71 and 89–103 placeholders. Detached columns do not represent group numbers; group is null there.
schemaNotes.scope: 118 currently recognised named elements. Beginner facts and uses are original Traditional Chinese paraphrases; facts are distinguished from the source wording. No isotope masses or electron configurations are included.
schemaNotes.chinese: Common Traditional Chinese names; the 20 notes names match Hong Kong usage. Some rare-element spellings follow Taiwanese standard forms, with useful regional variants in aliases. Silicon is 矽, alias 硅. Mercury is 汞, alias 水銀. 117/118 use the Unicode characters 鿬/鿫 rather than component descriptions.
schemaNotes.classification: Broad classroom display convention: B, Si, Ge, As, Sb, Te are metalloids; Po is metal; At is nonmetal. Boundary classifications vary among references. For 109–118 categoryProvisional is true: display the category as provisional and do not present position-based classification as experimentally established bulk properties. No physical state is asserted for superheavy elements. In particular Ts/Og are placed with group 17/18 nonmetals as a table convention, not a claim that either is a normal gas.
schemaNotes.sourceLimits: The older university table is consulted for names only; its masses/other values are not copied. Modern IUPAC names/order supersede older names. No RSC artwork or prose has been copied.
